criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 776 identifies Sigma Pi (SOSP), 130 Russell St; the official Sigma Pi location page independently confirms the chapter house at 130 N. Russell. Shell ring is rebuilt from the GIS outer ring with maximum nearest-vertex difference 0.000017 m.
criteria.deduction: GIS Shape__Area is 817.39 m2 while the recorded projected ring area is 472.87 m2; the service geometry's correspondence to structural wall line rather than roof edge is unverified.

criteria.evidence: The modeled shell reproduces the GIS ring in the project local campus approximation. Its wall bounds are [[-439.1611328125, -419.6351013183594], [-179.7059326171875, -146.538818359375], [0.25, 9.25]]; no independent rotation is introduced.
criteria.deduction: This verifies registration to the source polygon only, not independently surveyed building walls or dimensions. The GIS area conflict reduces confidence.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The 2004 chapter newsletter reports second-/third-deck work, which supports a multi-deck residential form. Asset wall height is 9.0 m, marked as an estimate.
criteria.deduction: No measured height or authoritative roof survey was found. The flat roof plane is explicitly estimated; source GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=12 conflict with the historical deck reference.

criteria.evidence: Historical source supports broad stucco/wood trim cues; preview shows three window rows, horizontal courses, and a modest entry on the shell.
criteria.deduction: No inspected current facade photo, plan, or elevation supports window rhythm, counts, entry placement, or roof silhouette. These features are model estimates, not source-verified architectural details.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Saved asset reopens under Blender 5.2.3; the expected named asset collection and scene exist, with one building library and no external unpacked image/material texture paths. The audit includes a raw GIS snapshot, historical PDF, source register, reopen record, and preview.
criteria.deduction: None. The manifest discrepancy and pending master integration are recorded separately as coordinator handoff findings; they do not reduce this criterion's asset export, portability, or evidence score.

evidence.historical_source_summary: The November 2004 Eta Data newsletter describes a 1912 older section, an addition rededicated in 1989, stucco/wood-trim exterior work, and second-/third-deck work. It provides no measured dimensions, facade schedule, or roof survey.

findings: Strong source-derived campus footprint and identity; the registered shell tracks the GIS ring to sub-millimeter precision.
GIS ring area and Shape__Area attribute conflict substantially; wall-to-ring alignment is not independently established.
Height, roof form, windows, and entrance remain mostly estimated due lack of inspected current facade imagery or measured plans.
Shared manifest still has stale original object count and 16 m bounds; coordinator should update it before closing the building handoff.
